svg.title: Lower memory with supported hybrid tasks
svg.desc: Matched local signed-in-like fixture, three reordered sessions per mode on M1 Pro. After ten task mixes, stock four-WebKit footprint was 371–379 MiB versus 75–76 MiB with three API views and one retained WebKit view. After ten native actions, stock was 438–443 MiB versus 221–222 MiB hybrid, a paired 49.3–50.1 percent reduction. All views retained. Native physical footprint includes client helpers, not summed RSS or globally deduplicated RAM. No live-site benchmark.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keep the session. Use less RAM.
